(2) The gloved hand pours a clear liquid from a clear bottle into the pot, causing large orange flames to erupt and engulf the ingredients. (3) A sequence showing a buffet area with various green leafy vegetables, onions, and mushrooms in wooden bins. A hand scoops fluffy white rice into a bowl and then pours thick braised meat and a quail egg over it. (4) Close-up shots of a variety of noodles in colorful packaging on a shelf, followed by a ladle stirring a thick, grainy brown satay sauce. (5) A hand opens an ice cream freezer, and a metal cup holds a swirl of dark chocolate soft-serve ice cream. (6) The scene returns to the pot where more seafood, including clams and squid, are added along with basil leaves. Broth is poured from a metal pitcher into the pot. (8) A large wooden platter filled with raw shrimp and squid on a bed of ice is displayed. A tray with a slice of cheesecake and the words 'Happy Birthday' written in chocolate sauce is shown. (9) The camera pans across a modern restaurant interior with orange chairs and warm pendant lighting, finally showing the red storefront with white text signage.
